content.short: Linea is a high-performance zkEVM Layer 2 rollup developed by Consensys to scale Ethereum applications.
content.description:
Linea is a developer-ready Layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum, powered by Zero-Knowledge Ethereum Virtual Machine (zkEVM) technology. Developed by Consensys, the team behind MetaMask, Linea offers full EVM equivalence, allowing developers to deploy existing Ethereum dApps with zero code modifications. By utilizing ZK-proofs, the network provides high throughput and significantly lower gas fees while inheriting the robust security of the Ethereum mainnet.

As a foundational infrastructure for the decentralized web, Linea supports a wide range of use cases including DeFi, gaming, and social applications. The network uses ETH for gas fees and features a sophisticated architecture designed for seamless interoperability and scalability. Through its commitment to open-source principles and deep integration with the Consensys stack, Linea is empowering the next generation of builders to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly decentralized applications for global adoption.
content.meta: Linea is a zkEVM Layer 2 network by Consensys, providing scalable and secure infrastructure for Ethereum dApps.
